formula_or_clause: D_v Gamma_eff = L_cg^-2 F_m D_v m - 2 Gamma_eff D_v ln L_cg
interpretation: Exact chain-rule route once Gamma_eff formula-shape is adopted.

required_input: m must be q-basic or an invariant scalar of the quotient parent state.
interpretation: Would kill the first D_v Gamma_eff source leg.

required_input: L_cg must be q-basic or fixed by quotient-invariant coarse-graining geometry.
interpretation: Would kill the second D_v Gamma_eff source leg.

formula_or_clause: C_DvGamma_total := |P_obs nabla(L_cg^-2 F_m D_v m - 2 Gamma_eff D_v ln L_cg)|/a_ref
required_input: Requires sourced m profile, L_cg profile, F_m normalization, projection P_obs and local acceleration/reference norm.
interpretation: This is the first measurable coefficient if the zero theorem fails.
